calculation.description: For each tradable asset, estimate rolling 60-day beta to the equal-weight cross-asset return, subtract beta times market return from daily return, then fade the five-day residual shock scaled by 20-day residual volatility. Higher values indicate stronger rebound potential.

validation.regime_notes: 20-day predictive IC was positive overall; annual IC means: 2026 +0.07551 (93 dates), 2027 -0.08220 (261), 2028 -0.02780 (260), 2029 -0.00265 (261), 2030 +0.01906 (257). Short horizons were negative, so use only at approximately 20-day horizon and treat regime dependence conservatively.
